_comment: WHY: The task suite (build step 3) -- HumanEval/MBPP-style problems, each shipping with hidden tests the sandbox runs. Kept as data so the suite is identical across runs, which fair regression comparison requires. NEEDS: 15-20 tasks with a mix of difficulty (some that pass first try, some that need retries, a few that may never pass). Each task: task_id, prompt (signature + docstring), entry_point (function name), test_code (Python that defines individual test functions calling the entry point). Delete this example entry once real tasks are added.
